create_RethinkSampler: create a RethinkSampler instance with a model, strategy, max rethinks, parsers, prompt generator, and game adapter
sample_action_with_text_and_state_input: sample an action using text input and game state by calling sample_action_with_text_and_state_input on a RethinkSampler
sample_action_with_image_text_and_state_: sample an action using image and text input by calling sample_action_with_image_text_and_state_input on a RethinkSampler
define_RethinkStrategy: define a RethinkStrategy enum value such as RETHINK, RETHINK_WITH_ENV, RETHINK_WITH_ENV_ILLEGAL_HISTORY, or RETHINK_WITH_ENV_RULE
check_is_rethink_template: check if a prompt template is a valid rethink template by calling is_rethink_template on a RethinkSampler
